content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing required prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A formal appeal is the only available payer-compliant action that can still pursue payment; although similar-claim success is low, it has produced payment and is preferable to an unsupported resubmission or premature patient billing/write-off.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
